assets.prompt: Four 16x16 frames side by side of a cobweb lying on the floor: two webs at rest (eight spokes from a knot and two rings, a thread or two broken, in Bone shades), two burning (the same webs in Fire and Spark shades, a few threads gone). Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no outline (floor decoration).
